title: Synthesis and catalytic application of bimetallic-MOFs in synthesis of new class of phenylnicotinonitriles
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27782-27794
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04067A, Paper

Mahrokh Farrokh, Mohammad Ali Zolfigol, Maryam Hajjami, Hassan Sepehrmansourie, Milad Mohammadi Rasooll
A new approach in the synthesis of new porous copper-containing complex based on bimetallic Fe- and Co-based MOFs for the preparation of phenylnicotinonitriles under green and mild conditions is presented.
